text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I headed to the training track, I found Zenno Rob Roy reading a letter with a smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"This is... a very sweet fan letter
that was sent to me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy showed me the letter.
Written upon it, in clumsy, childlike handwriting,
were sincere feelings of admiration.

text_block_list.name: Letter from a Child
text_block_list.text:
"Rob Roy-san, you were amazing!
You looked so nervous, but once you started running, you were so fast!"

text_block_list.name: Letter from a Child
text_block_list.text:
"I get nervous really easily too,
so I felt like I had to do my best!"

text_block_list.name: Letter from a Child
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna write about this in my school essay!
Good luck to you too, Rob Roy!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
She is just like me,
trying to change little by little...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And she's trying to write down
my story in the form of an essay.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
As people's feelings intertwine, stories
are woven together little by little like this, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—Right, I can't just stand around!
I have to work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And I want to create
many stories together!
